title: Amylase and lipase
what: This blood test checks two enzymes made by the pancreas. When the pancreas is inflamed, their levels in the blood go up.
why: For severe pain in the upper belly, especially pain that spreads to the back, when pancreatitis is suspected, and to follow pancreas conditions.
duration: the blood draw usually takes 5 minutes; urgent results come in a few hours, usually in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: When the pain started and where it hurts
If you drank alcohol or ate fatty food the day before

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually on an empty stomach: 8 to 12 hours without food. Water is fine. If your belly hurts badly, the test is done right away. Do not wait.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take.

steps: You sit down, and a band is tied above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
Blood is taken from a vein into a tube
The band is removed, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Results usually come in 1 to 2 days, urgent ones in a few hours
The doctor reads the test together with your symptoms and an ultrasound
red_flags: Severe belly pain spreading to the back, with vomiting: call emergency services
Pain with fever or yellow skin or eyes: see a doctor right away or call emergency services

faq.q: If the enzymes are normal, is there definitely no pancreatitis?
faq.a: Not always. Sometimes the enzymes drop quickly. The doctor also looks at your pain and an ultrasound.

faq.q: How is lipase different from amylase?
faq.a: Lipase points more precisely to the pancreas. Amylase can be high for other reasons too.

reminders.text: Amylase and lipase test tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner, and no alcohol. Water is fine.
